scripts.build:central: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$env:VITE_APP_FLAVOR='central-workstation'; npm --prefix ../frontend-react run build" && shx rm -rf dist/central && shx cp -r ../frontend-react/dist dist/central
scripts.build:ratemaker: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$env:VITE_APP_FLAVOR='rate-maker'; npm --prefix ../frontend-react run build" && shx rm -rf dist/rate-maker && shx cp -r ../frontend-react/dist dist/rate-maker
scripts.build:frontend: shx rm -rf dist && shx mkdir -p dist && npm run build:central && npm run build:ratemaker
scripts.build: npm run build:electron && npm run build:frontend
